title: two gaps an install test on a real server found: buildx for make images, SSH=off over SSH
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the install test's report (F-5, F-6) and by the card's unit tests with stand-ins; not re-run on a real host.

findings.claim: make images failed on a Docker host without the buildx plugin with Docker's own legacy-builder error (the Dockerfiles use RUN --mount), and runbook 01 step 2 did not name buildx; make images and images-multiarch now stop first with a line naming buildx, and the runbook names it with its check

deploy/hardening/apply.sh with SSH=off, the example's default, stopped sshd and dropped port 22 under an install run over SSH, locking it out; it now refuses from an SSH session and changes nothing, and install.sh asks the same rule at its start, before it loads anything, unless --ssh-off-over-ssh (apply.sh or install.sh) or TB_SSH_OFF_OVER_SSH=yes is given
